text:
You're not poor. You're lazy with your desire.

Truly wanting money means: you believe it's yours. You burn for it. You fail, you learn, you try again. You have a written plan and you execute it today.

Most men do step one only. They believe money exists. Then they go home and scroll.

Belief without burning desire is just wishing.
Desire without persistence is just talking.
Persistence without a plan is just noise.

You need all four or you need to stop blaming bad luck.

Stop wishing. Start proving you actually want this.
caption:
Your desire isn't a feeling. It's the mindset and discipline you choose every single day.
Send this to a man who needs it today.
